lines: I have a lot of experience with the Pterodactyl and Coolify panels, but for my own services I now prefer pure Docker because it means less overhead and more control.
I have a lot of productive experience with MariaDB and I've tested Supabase extensively, both in the cloud and self hosted.
I use Cloudflare for DNS, HetrixTools for monitoring, Trello and Notion for project management for ShadowUnity, and Vercel for automatic deployments.
+My browser survival game stranded-horizons is the one project still on Vercel auto-deploys: https://github.com/drosemann/stranded-horizons
On the client side I use Windows, with a nod to the games industry, and I plan to switch to Linux as soon as anticheat support gets better.
My focus is on cybersecurity, AI, cloud and virtualization, and automation with Python.
My hosting path went from Aternos to Ploudos to Minehub, which later closed.
